promise_bar.text: Repair first, replace only when warranted

promise_band.headline: The Honest Diagnosis First
promise_band.body: The most expensive thing in this trade is a contractor who quotes a replacement when a repair would have done. We work the other way around. We test the system, we tell you what is actually wrong, and if it can be fixed we say so — even though the replacement would have been worth more to us. One customer wrote that three other businesses got the assessment wrong before we sat down and explained the real problem. That is the whole business in one sentence.

signature_system.headline: Comfort, Diagnosed Properly
signature_system.intro: Every Comfortable Climate job runs the same way, whether it is a no-heat call at 6am in January or a full ductless installation. You get the diagnosis, the number, and the work — in that order.

blocks.title: A written estimate before we start
blocks.body: We analyze the work and put the scope and the price in your hand so you can say yes or no based on what it actually costs. Customers have written that the final cost was within the estimate and there were no additional charges or fees at the end.

blocks.title: Factory-trained on what we install
blocks.body: Comfortable Climate was awarded Fujitsu "Elite Contractor" status for 2024. It reflects the level of training our staff have earned on that equipment, and it means an advanced level of support and service on every ductless system we put in.

blocks.title: A free carbon monoxide check with every heating repair
blocks.body: Combustion equipment gets checked whether or not that is what you called us about. It takes a few minutes and it is not an upsell — it is part of the visit.

signature_system.steps_title: We work in your house like it's ours

steps.title: Nothing gets scuffed on the way in
steps.body: A customer specifically noted we took care not to bump new storm doors and freshly painted walls while carrying a water heater down narrow basement steps.

steps.title: We leave it cleaner than we found it

guarantee.title: Licensed, insured, and standing behind it
guarantee.body: Pennsylvania registration PA #091633, carried and current. Plumbing repairs come with a 2-year warranty, and we register new equipment so the manufacturer's warranty is active from day one rather than sitting unclaimed in a drawer.

about_block.headline: Let Our Family Serve Your Family
about_block.body: For over 25 years Comfortable Climate has provided comfort, peace of mind and healthy environments for residential and commercial customers across Northeastern Pennsylvania. Owner Joe Szczechowicz still does the estimates himself — which is why so many of our reviews name him personally rather than a company. By installing, maintaining and servicing HVAC and plumbing systems we offer warmth, relief from the heat, clean fresh air and a reliable water supply.
checklist: Locally owned and operated in Dallas, PA
Heating, air conditioning and plumbing under one contractor
about_block.photo_alt: Joe Szczechowicz, owner of Comfortable Climate HVAC

seo_body.headline: Heating & Air Conditioning In The Back Mountain
paragraphs: Northeastern Pennsylvania asks a lot of a heating system. The Back Mountain sits higher and colder than the valley floor, so furnaces and boilers up here run harder and longer than the same equipment does in Wilkes-Barre — and then summer humidity hands the job straight to the air conditioning.

We service every make and model, oil, gas, propane, electric and geothermal, and we are factory-trained on Fujitsu ductless equipment for the additions, converted attics and older homes where ductwork was never run. If a system can be repaired we repair it. If it genuinely needs replacing, you get the sizing and the reasoning before you get the price.
checklist: Furnaces, boilers, heat pumps and ductless mini-splits
Central air repair, tune-ups and replacement
Free carbon monoxide check with every heating repair

faqs.q: Do I need a new system, or can mine be repaired?
faqs.a: In most cases it can be repaired, and we will tell you when that is true even though a replacement is worth more to us. We test the system, explain what is actually failing, and quote the repair. We only recommend replacement when the cost of the repair stops making sense against the age and condition of the equipment.

faqs.q: Are estimates free, and will the final bill match?
faqs.a: Estimates are free. You get a written scope and a price before any work begins, and that is what you pay. Customers have written specifically that the final cost was within the estimate range and there were no additional charges or fees.

We are based in Dallas, PA and work throughout Luzerne, Lackawanna and Wyoming counties — including Wilkes-Barre, Kingston, Scranton, Clarks Summit and Tunkhannock, plus the Back Mountain towns around us.

Yes. No heat in January and no cooling in July are not things that wait for an appointment slot. Call (570) 333-0380. Customers have written about being back in heat inside two days during the coldest week of the year, and about a Saturday air conditioning call during the hottest.

faqs.q: What brands do you service and install?
faqs.a: We service every make and model. We install and maintain Fujitsu, Trane, Carrier, Lennox, Rheem, Ruud, York, Bryant, Goodman, American Standard, Comfortmaker and Honeywell equipment, among others. We hold Fujitsu Elite Contractor status for 2024 on their ductless line.

faqs.q: Do you do plumbing as well as HVAC?
faqs.a: Yes, and it is the same phone call. Water heaters, burst and frozen pipes, sump and sewage pumps, well pumps, fixtures and drains. All plumbing repairs carry a 2-year warranty.

faqs.q: What is a ductless mini-split, and do I need one?
faqs.a: A mini-split heats and cools a room without ductwork, using a small indoor head connected to an outdoor unit. They are the right answer for additions, converted attics, sunrooms and older homes where running ducts is impractical or expensive. We are factory-trained on Fujitsu ductless systems and can tell you quickly whether one fits your situation.
